tagline.en: Miami to Lake Superior, across the Everglades to begin with
tagline.zh: 自迈阿密穿越大沼泽，北抵苏必利尔湖

start.zh: 佛罗里达州迈阿密，与 US 1 相接

end.en: Copper Harbor, Michigan, on Lake Superior
end.zh: 密歇根州科珀港，苏必利尔湖畔

en: US 41 begins in Miami as the Tamiami Trail, which is the only reason most people know the number. For about fifty miles it runs dead straight west across the sawgrass of the Everglades and the cypress of Big Cypress, a two-lane road on a causeway with a borrow canal beside it, before turning north at Naples for Fort Myers, Sarasota and Tampa.

North of Tampa it becomes an inland road, threading Florida's middle through Brooksville and Lake City, then Valdosta, Macon and Atlanta. This was the way to Florida before I-75, and through Georgia the two are rarely far apart. Beyond Chattanooga it takes in Nashville, Evansville and Terre Haute, skirts Chicago's south side and runs up the west shore of Lake Michigan through Milwaukee and Green Bay.

The last third is the strangest. US 41 crosses into Michigan's Upper Peninsula and keeps going north through Escanaba, Marquette and Houghton, out along the Keweenaw Peninsula into the old copper mining country, and ends at a turnaround in the woods at Copper Harbor, on Lake Superior — about as far from the Everglades in climate as the numbered system reaches.
zh: US 41 自迈阿密起步，即是「坦迈阿密路」（Tamiami Trail）；多数人知道这个编号，也正因为这一段。约五十英里内，它笔直西行，穿过大沼泽的锯齿草与大柏树沼泽的柏木林——一条筑于路堤上的双车道公路，旁边是取土开挖的运河——随后在那不勒斯折向北，前往迈尔斯堡、萨拉索塔与坦帕。
坦帕以北，它变成一条内陆道路，穿过佛罗里达腹地的布鲁克斯维尔与莱克城，再经瓦尔多斯塔、梅肯与亚特兰大。在 I-75 出现之前，这就是南下佛罗里达的通道；在佐治亚州境内，两者大多相距不远。过查塔努加后，它途经纳什维尔、埃文斯维尔与特雷霍特，擦过芝加哥南部，再沿密歇根湖西岸北上，经密尔沃基与格林贝。
最后三分之一最为奇特。US 41 进入密歇根上半岛后继续北行，经埃斯卡纳巴、马凯特与霍顿，沿基威诺半岛深入旧铜矿区，最终止于苏必利尔湖畔科珀港林间的一处回车道——就气候而言，这大概是编号系统中距大沼泽最远的地方。

en: The Tamiami Trail was proposed in 1915 by representatives of Fort Myers and Miami who wanted a road between the two coasts; Tampa's delegate then argued for extending it north, and the two city names were spliced together. Each county on the line agreed to build and pay for its own portion. Lee County ran out of money in 1919 and Monroe County built the stretch instead on a slightly different line, which survives as Loop Road. The road was finished on the original alignment only after Barron Collier, a New York advertising millionaire who had bought a great deal of southwest Florida, agreed to bankroll it — in return for which the legislature created a county named after him.

When the numbered system was approved on 11 November 1926, US 41 ran from Naples, Florida, to Copper Harbor, Michigan. The east–west leg across the Everglades was a separate number: it opened in April 1928 as US 94. Only in June 1949 did AASHO extend US 41 from Naples to Miami and delete US 94 between the two, giving the Tamiami Trail a single designation for the first time.

The northern end is older than the highway system by a long way. US 41 in the Keweenaw follows the Military Road built through the copper country in the 1860s and 1870s. Michigan made the section from Central to Copper Harbor its first scenic heritage route on 26 September 1995, and on 22 September 2005 US 41 north of Houghton was designated the Copper Country Trail under the National Scenic Byways programme.
zh: 坦迈阿密路由迈尔斯堡与迈阿密两地代表于 1915 年提出，意在打通东西两岸；坦帕的代表随后主张向北延伸，于是把两个城市的名字拼在了一起。沿线各县约定各自出资修建本县路段。1919 年李县资金告罄，改由门罗县以略有出入的线位代建，那段路以「环线路」之名保留至今。直到纽约广告业富商巴伦·科利尔——他已在佛罗里达西南部购置了大量土地——同意出资兜底，这条路才终于按原线位建成；作为交换，州议会设立了一个以他命名的县。
1926 年 11 月 11 日编号系统获批时，US 41 自佛罗里达州那不勒斯通往密歇根州科珀港。横穿大沼泽的那段东西向路是另一个编号：它于 1928 年 4 月以 US 94 之名通车。直到 1949 年 6 月，AASHO 才把 US 41 自那不勒斯延伸至迈阿密，并撤销两地之间的 US 94，坦迈阿密路这才首次拥有单一编号。
北端比公路系统古老得多。基威诺半岛上的 US 41 沿用 1860 至 1870 年代穿越铜矿区修建的军用道路。密歇根州于 1995 年 9 月 26 日把中央镇至科珀港一段定为该州首条景观遗产道路；2005 年 9 月 22 日，霍顿以北的 US 41 又依国家景观道计划被定名为「铜乡之路」。

en: The Everglades section is being partly demolished on purpose. Built as a solid embankment, the Tamiami Trail acts as a dam across the top of Shark River Slough: water north of it has to be held well below the crown of the road or the roadbed fails, which starves Everglades National Park of the sheet flow it was built on.

The first fix was a one-mile bridge just north of the park boundary, contracted in 2009 and opened to traffic in March 2013, together with the reinforcement of about ten miles of the remaining roadway so that canal levels could be raised behind it. A second phase followed under a state-federal agreement: the originally planned 2.6-mile western bridge was built as two structures totalling 2.3 miles, substantially complete in January 2019. Further bridging has been studied but not funded.
zh: 大沼泽路段正被有计划地部分拆除。坦迈阿密路以实心路堤筑成，等于在鲨鱼河沼泽上游横起一道坝：路北的水位必须压得远低于路面标高，否则路基就会破坏，而这使大沼泽国家公园失去了赖以存在的漫流补给。
第一步的补救措施是在公园边界以北修建一座一英里长的桥，2009 年发包，2013 年 3 月通车，同时对余下约十英里路面进行加固，使其后方的运河水位得以抬升。随后依州与联邦的协议实施第二阶段：原计划 2.6 英里的西段桥梁改建为两座、合计 2.3 英里的结构，于 2019 年 1 月基本完工。进一步的架桥方案已有研究，但尚未落实资金。

value.en: An estimated $7 million for the whole construction, completed in April 1928
value.zh: 全部工程估计耗资 700 万美元，1928 年 4 月完工

figures.source: National Park Service, Big Cypress National Preserve, "Tamiami Trail & Monroe Station"

label.zh: 坦迈阿密路改造工程：一英里桥

value.en: $81 million contract awarded in 2009, covering the bridge, removal of a mile of old roadway and reinforcement of about 9.7 miles; the bridge opened to traffic in March 2013
value.zh: 2009 年发包，合同额 8,100 万美元，含桥梁、拆除一英里旧路面及加固约 9.7 英里路段；桥梁于 2013 年 3 月通车

figures.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Modified Water Deliveries to Everglades National Park project fact sheet

label.zh: 坦迈阿密路「后续步骤」第一期

value.en: A construction contract of just over $97 million awarded by FDOT in June 2016; the planned 2.6-mile western bridge was built as two bridges totalling 2.3 miles, substantially complete in January 2019
value.zh: 佛州交通部于 2016 年 6 月发包，合同额略高于 9,700 万美元；原计划 2.6 英里的西段桥梁改建为两座、合计 2.3 英里，2019 年 1 月基本完工

figures.source: National Park Service, "Tamiami Trail: Next Steps"

why.en: No figure exists for the route as a whole. US 41 was numbered in 1926 over existing roads in eight states and the only segment with a construction history of its own is the Tamiami Trail.
why.zh: 全线并无此类数据。US 41 于 1926 年沿 8 个州的既有道路编号，唯一拥有独立建设史的路段是坦迈阿密路。

why.en: No current authoritative figure exists. AASHTO delegates U.S. Route mileage to the states and last published a national log in 1989; US 41 has been shortened at both ends and rerouted around cities many times since.
why.zh: 目前没有权威数据。AASHTO 把美国国道里程交由各州统计，最后一份全国里程表发布于 1989 年；此后 US 41 两端均有缩短，并多次改线绕开城市。

why.en: Eight state agencies publish counts by segment. US 41 is an eight-lane urban arterial in Tampa, Atlanta and Milwaukee and a two-lane road through Big Cypress and the Keweenaw; no combined figure exists.
why.zh: 8 个州的机构按路段发布统计。US 41 在坦帕、亚特兰大与密尔沃基是八车道城市干道，在大柏树沼泽与基威诺半岛则是双车道公路；并无合并数字。

label.en: Effect of the one-mile bridge on water flow
label.zh: 一英里桥对水流的影响

value.en: Raising the L-29 Canal to a maximum of 8.5 feet behind the bridge is estimated to increase annual flow volumes into Everglades National Park by about 92 per cent
value.zh: 桥后 L-29 运河水位最高抬升至 8.5 英尺，预计可使流入大沼泽国家公园的年径流量增加约 92%

conditionFigures.source: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Modified Water Deliveries to Everglades National Park project fact sheet

timeline.en: A road between Florida's two coasts is proposed; Tampa's delegate has it extended north and the name Tamiami is coined.
timeline.zh: 有人提议修建一条连接佛罗里达东西两岸的道路；坦帕代表主张向北延伸，「坦迈阿密」之名由此而来。

timeline.en: US 41 is approved on 11 November, from Naples, Florida, to Copper Harbor, Michigan.
timeline.zh: 11 月 11 日 US 41 获批，自佛罗里达州那不勒斯至密歇根州科珀港。

timeline.en: The Tamiami Trail opens across the Everglades in April, carrying the number US 94.
timeline.zh: 4 月，坦迈阿密路横穿大沼泽通车，编号为 US 94。

timeline.en: AASHO extends US 41 from Naples to Miami in June and deletes US 94 between them.
timeline.zh: 6 月，AASHO 把 US 41 自那不勒斯延伸至迈阿密，并撤销两地之间的 US 94。

timeline.en: A one-mile bridge north of Everglades National Park opens, the first section of the trail to be replaced by a span.
timeline.zh: 大沼泽国家公园以北的一英里桥通车，成为该路首段以桥梁取代路堤的路段。

timeline.en: Two further bridges totalling 2.3 miles are substantially complete on the western section.
timeline.zh: 西段另两座、合计 2.3 英里的桥梁基本完工。
